remarks: Lovely first floor of an antique home in a quiet beach community. Unique architectural features, high ceilings, big windows and hardwood floors. Spacious kitchen has granite counter tops. Relax on the front porch or in the large yard; the landlord takes care of lawn maintenance. It's a short walk to Cummings Park and Beach, West Beach and Cove Island or a quick ride to downtown, Stamford train station, I-95, Harbor Point and Chelsea Piers.
